title: Bitmask Subsets XOR Sum
statement: Given an array of N integers, find the sum of all XOR totals for every subset of the array. The XOR total of a subset is the bitwise XOR of all its elements (empty subset has XOR total 0).
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.
output_format: Output a single integer, the total sum of subset XOR values.
